boundaries: Each DeerFlow database is copied with its -wal and -shm files and each copy's sha256 is verified; only sqlite_master names and the named runs columns are read, and the copy is deleted. No user, password, token, session or credential table is read, and no SELECT * is issued.
Per-run home and state trees, credential files and configuration holding keys are not read.
Question and query text is not published; the topic is a model-written heading or title. Each withheld field is counted, with its reason, under withheld.
A pass flag is metadata only and never replaces primary-source review.

Seeds are cited GitHub owner/repo identities (seeds) and the canonical URLs of every other cited public http(s) link (named_urls), without screen_generic's badge, image and sponsor links. A name with no link at all is not extracted.
